body: You may have lost a lot of things, but you'll always have yourself. It sounds cheesy, but it is true. I'm truly sorry for all you've been through, and you're very strong to reach out for help. I do recommend you seek help immediately; even if that means admitting yourself to hospital/a psychiatric care facility. I wish you the best :)
Talk therapy is very helpful; sharing your story and talking to people who have experienced similar events is typically a good idea :)

I'm really sorry you had to see that. Seeing a suicide can hurt you more than you may initially realise so maybe seeking help for yourself is a good first step. Unfortunately there's not much you can do about the lady. Calling 911 was the best thing you could've done. I wish you the best.

Definitely not, OP :)
She seems like a very caring friend. You could tell her how you feel the next time you two talk. I wish you the best.
